verdict.rationale: Cursor documents an MCP marketplace with one-click OAuth install of third-party servers, JSON-based custom MCP config, enterprise admin controls, and integrations with GitHub, Slack, Linear, Bitbucket, etc., which supports bringing partner-built tools/agents into workflows. However, this is entirely first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on evidence of actual third-party 'agent app' integrations working reliably in practice. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of specific partner agent-app integrations, evidence of a broader partner ecosystem beyond MCP tool servers, and hands-on reports validating real-world use.
